patterns.key_values: ~330-360pt wide borderless graphite popover; segmented tab bar top; hero status + charge card + key/value health table + energy-users list + disclosure row; dark mode
two-column key/value health table: left secondary-gray labels, right primary-white values (one green), right-aligned
energy-users rows = leading orange lightning glyph + app name + trailing horizontal amber bar meter (relative draw)
segmented tab bar as primary nav with 1pt separators and solid-blue selected fill

signature_moves: Telemetry-as-identity: raw electrical data (14.5 W, 11.38 V, 8575/8579 mAh, 32.6 C, 102 cycles) promoted to primary hero content, not hidden in an advanced pane
Label-inside-fill charge pill: the '24%' status pill sits within the leading end of the progress track, fusing value+label+fill into one object
Disciplined status-color triad - blue=selection, green=good, orange=energy-cost - each color one meaning, each paired with a glyph (color-never-alone)
defects: Contrast Dilution (mild) - tertiary caption 'Relative battery use right now' est. <4.5:1 on graphite
Selection-grammar deviation (native-tell) - solid saturated-blue tab fill instead of native tinted-inset selection
Segmented-control-as-primary-navigation (native-tell) - HIG reserves segmented for in-view scope switching
REJECTED as defect: right-column values appear higher than left labels due to ~2.4deg marketing perspective tilt, not real misalignment

aesthetic.direction: Neo-grotesque product (dark) - graphite neutral ramp with system-color status pops, native macOS flavored

psychology: Jakob's Law - mimics the native macOS battery menu-bar dropdown layout so users read it instantly
Hierarchy via de-emphasis - gray labels vs white values drive the health table (processing fluency)
Von Restorff / signal detection - the single blue selected tab is the one thing that pops
Color-never-alone honored - green/orange status always paired with a glyph+label
Progressive disclosure - deeper data hidden behind 'Battery details >' row
Miller/Cowan chunking - content grouped into ~4 chunks (status / charge / health / energy)
notes: ONLY a marketing cover composite was supplied (no standalone screenshots). The app window is rendered at a ~2.4deg clockwise perspective tilt, so ALL measurements are estimated with wide ranges and material/glass detail is unreadable - era 'big-sur' and lineage 'native' are both low-confidence; a clean un-tilted shot of any surface would firm both. Glass presence is insufficient-evidence, not absent. Panel width (~330-360pt) and absence of traffic lights indicate a menu-bar-extra popover, not a primary window. Corpus is at Novice: this is the FIRST app profiled (only the macOS-27 kit precedes it) - no canon promotions possible. Workflow A (UI) only per task; an icon.png exists and is flagged for a later Workflow B digest. Brand identity (violet/pink gradient wordmark, navy hero) is distinct from the app's graphite UI - recorded as brand evidence, excluded from macOS canon.
